lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₁₀Sn₂Sb₄ (reduced formula Mg₅SnSb₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg, Sb, and Sn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Sb, and Mg–Sn coordination involving mixed Mg/Sn and Mg/Sb neighbor sets. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing, while Mg–Sb and Mg–Sn pairs share corners and edges.
